SAMPLE AGREEMENT 2030-2032
ARTICLE 1: PURPOSE
1.01 The purpose of this Agreement is to set out terms of employment.
1.02 Nothing in this Agreement shall be read as limiting
any right under statute.
ARTICLE 2: WAGES
2.01 The monthly rate for a Grade 1 position shall be:
1500
per month, as set out in Appendix A.
2.02 Employees may not be paid less than the rate in
Article 2.01 (a) of this Agreement for any month.
- 2 -
\f
SAMPLE AGREEMENT 2030-2032
ARTICLE 3: HOURS OF WORK
3.01 Regular Hours
The regular work day is eight (8) hours.
3.02 The Employer will not schedule split shifts. An Employee cannot be required to work more than
twelve (12) hours in a day. The Association will not strike during the term of this Agreement.
3.03 Overtime shall be paid at 150% after twenty-
one (21) days of continuous assignment.
- 3 -
\f
SAMPLE AGREEMENT 2030-2032
LETTER OF UNDERSTANDING
between the Employer and the Association
Re: Remote Work
1. The parties agree that remote work may be approved by the Employer.
2. Requests shall be answered within ten (10) days.
1.01 This letter expires on June 30, 2032.

\f
SAMPLE AGREEMENT 2030-2032
APPENDIX A: WAGE GRID
1.01 Grade 1 is paid $1,500.00 per month.
1.02 Grade 2 is paid $1,650.00 per month.
